hooks.command: echo '🔍 Running golangci-lint (make lint) before commit...'; cache="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/aether-lint-cache"; mkdir -p "$cache/go-build" "$cache/gomodcache" "$cache/golangci-lint"; out=$(TMPDIR="$cache" GOCACHE="$cache/go-build" GOMODCACHE="$cache/gomodcache" GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE="$cache/golangci-lint" make lint 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || echo "$out" | grep -q 'typechecking error'; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi; echo "$out"
